**Abstract**

See [KR5c0051](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0051) for the full treatment. Summary: The *Zhuāngzǐ* in the received 33-chapter Guō Xiàng redaction (c. 290–312 CE) is the second of the three foundational Daoist classics (with the *Dàodé jīng* and the *Yìjīng*). The inner chapters (*Nèi piān*, chs. 1–7) are widely attributed to Zhuāng Zhōu himself (fl. late 4th cent. BCE); the outer (*Wài piān*) and miscellaneous (*Zá piān*) chapters are the work of his followers and later tradition.

**Dating.** Per the project convention for layered works: –340 to 312 CE. Dynasty: 周.
